title: 蜜蜂怎么做蜂蜜
subtitle: 一只蜜蜂一辈子，只做一小勺
character: wearing a yellow t-shirt, brown shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, linocut print on warm cream paper, bold carved shapes with strong black lines, limited palette of honey gold, warm brown and leaf green, visible carving marks

pages.zh:
早饭的面包上，
我抹了一层蜂蜜，
甜甜的，黏黏的。
这罐蜂蜜，
是谁做出来的呢？
pages.scene: The little boy sits at a breakfast table spreading honey on a slice of bread with a spoon, a honey jar beside him.

pages.zh:
蜜蜂住在蜂巢里。
一个蜂巢里，
可能住着几万只蜜蜂。
它们分工干活：
有的出门采蜜，有的在家照顾幼虫。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one hive shape on a cream background filled with a grid of six-sided cells, with several simple bees on it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
花朵为了让蜜蜂来，
在花心里备了一点甜水，
叫做「花蜜」。
蜜蜂来喝甜水，
身上顺便沾满了花粉。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one flower seen in cross-section on a cream background with a small pool of nectar drawn at its centre. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
蜜蜂把花蜜吸进一个小袋子里，
那个袋子叫蜜囊，
不是它的胃。
装满了，
它就飞回蜂巢。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one bee seen from the side on a cream background with a small rounded sac drawn inside its body, separate from the stomach. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
回到家，
它把花蜜吐给另一只蜜蜂，
那只再吐给下一只。
传来传去的时候，
花蜜里的水越来越少。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three bees in a row on a cream background, each passing a drop to the next, with small arrows between them. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
然后它们把蜜吐进蜂房里，
一起扇翅膀。
几万只翅膀一起扇，
把水汽吹走，
蜜就变得越来越稠。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: several six-sided cells on a cream background filled with honey, with two bees above them and short curved lines showing moving air. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
水少到一定程度，
细菌就活不下去了，
所以蜂蜜放很久也不会坏。
最后蜜蜂用蜡
把蜂房封起来。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: a row of six-sided cells on a cream background, the left ones open and full of honey, the right ones sealed with a flat wax cap. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
蜂房为什么是六边形呢？
因为六边形一个挨一个，
中间不留空隙，
用最少的蜡，
装最多的蜜。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three shapes side by side on a cream background: a circle grid with gaps between circles, a square grid, and a six-sided grid with no gaps at all. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
找到好花的蜜蜂，
回家会跳一种舞。
转圈的方向和时间，
告诉同伴：
花在哪个方向、有多远。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one bee on a cream background walking a figure-of-eight path drawn as a dotted line, with one straight arrow through the middle of the eight. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
蜜蜂采蜜的时候，
把花粉从这朵花
带到那朵花上。
花才能结果。
我们吃的很多果子，都靠它们。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two flowers on a cream background with one bee flying between them, small dots of pollen drawn on the bee and on both flowers. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
一只工蜂一辈子，
大约只能做出
一小勺蜂蜜的十二分之一。
所以一罐蜂蜜，
是好多好多蜜蜂的一生。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one small teaspoon on a cream background with a very small drop of honey in it, and beside it one single bee. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我又舔了一口蜂蜜。
这一口，
可能是好几只蜜蜂
飞了好远好远才带回来的。
我慢慢地吃，不浪费。
pages.scene: The little boy holds his slice of honey bread with both hands and takes a careful small bite, eyes closed, enjoying it.
